proposed.sourceName: UAE Ministry of Industry & Advanced Technology (MOIAT / ESMA) — National Halal Program (UAE.S 2055-1 & UAE.S/GSO 993, Cabinet Decree 10/2014)
proposed.paraphrase: The UAE national halal standard (UAE.S 993 Islamic slaughter — Muslim slaughterer, animal alive, no torture; UAE.S 2055-1 general halal food) prohibits pork, alcohol, blood and unverified animal additives — meeting the hanafi-strict bar on alcohol/additive strictness. (Seafood caveat: the Gulf standard permits a broad range of seafood, an axis the app's hanafi-strict flags but does not currently enforce.)

researcherNote: ESMA/MOIAT permits stunning under GSO conditions → correctly NOT mapped to zabiha. hanafiStrict rests on strict alcohol/prohibited-substance controls; seafood axis is the known unenforced gap (flagged). APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01 (batch pre-approval).
